name: athena-erp-testing
description: Athena ERP web automation testing framework (TypeScript + Playwright)

scripts.platform:validate: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform.js validate
scripts.platform:module: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform.js module --path
scripts.platform:integration: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform.js integration --path
scripts.platform:file: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform.js file --path
scripts.platform:prd:modules: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-prd.js modules
scripts.platform:prd:validate: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-prd.js validate
scripts.platform:prd:scan: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-prd.js scan
scripts.platform:prd:scan:incremental: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-prd.js scan --incremental
scripts.platform:plan:compile: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-plan.js compile
scripts.platform:plan:validate: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-plan.js validate
scripts.platform:plan:dry-run: npm run build && node dist/cli/platform-plan.js dry-run
scripts.platform:check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:platform
scripts.phase2:doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js doctor
scripts.phase2:session: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js session:check
scripts.phase2:nav: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js nav
scripts.phase2:controls: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js controls
scripts.phase2:discover: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js discover
scripts.phase2:map: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js map
scripts.phase2:po:create: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js create-po
scripts.phase2:manifest:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js manifest:check
scripts.prd:help: npm run build && node dist/cli/prd.js help
scripts.prd:scan: npm run build && node dist/cli/prd.js scan
scripts.prd:scan:incremental: npm run build && node dist/cli/prd.js scan:incremental
scripts.prd:validate: npm run build && node dist/cli/prd.js validate
scripts.prd:report: npm run build && node dist/cli/prd.js report
scripts.prd:build: npm run build && node dist/cli/prd.js build
